description: Provenance + integrity manifest for the goldens the five offline regression nets consume. Records HASHES and PROVENANCE ONLY, never golden content: every golden here is a gitignored copyrighted-corpus derivative (console recordings, corpus-derived renders/fixtures). gate.ps1 reads this before running the nets and refuses to let a missing/altered golden silently shrink a net to a smaller PASS.

roots.CorpusRoot: the private .bcsar dump tree (gate -CorpusRoot; default E:\legoj\Documents\3DSWii Dumps\Dumps)
roots.LocalAppData: %LOCALAPPDATA% (per-machine golden caches; regenerated per-exe, self-guarded by each harness)

enforceLegend.sha: gate checks the file is present AND its sha256 matches; a gates=true row that fails marks its consuming net DEGRADED
enforceLegend.none: informational only (never-recorded captures, or LocalAppData goldens the harness already self-verifies); gate never degrades on these

notes: The silent-shrink hazard is real for ONE net only: console-tolerance skips any capture WAV that is absent (Where-Object Test-Path). Its two present console WAVs are the gates=true rows below. play-goldens and diag-goldens ERROR on a missing golden (no silent shrink), so their goldens are catalogued enforce=none/local-regenerated for provenance, not integrity.

Four of the six console-capture rows (the SE captures) are OBSOLETE, not a TODO: the isolated-note plan was abandoned 2026-07-14 because these SEs only fire inside a music sequence, so a standalone isolated-SE WAV is not physically capturable. Their calibration targets are already exercised by the battery-v2 tracks A/B rows below (present, sha-enforced). They are kept as explicit obsolete-superseded rows so the abandoned plan stays on record; each names the battery-v2 row that subsumes it. NOT a console capture job — do not resurrect isolated-SE capture. (Confirmed 2026-07-19: the analog rig is live but the SEs cannot be isolated.)
The battery captures gate nothing: analyze_capture_v2.py is measurement-only with no pass/fail exit. They are catalogued for integrity/provenance (gates=false).
